metadata.question: Did an island appear in the Caspian Sea within 4 km of coordinates 39.014501, 49.357405 on February 13, 2023, but did not exist on November 19, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare two specific dates: Nov 19, 2022 vs Feb 13, 2023 - Location: 39.014501°N, 49.357405°E (Caspian Sea) - Search within 4 km radius for an island appearance - Use Sentinel-2 for high resolution land/water detection - Need to detect land emergence in water 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is essential to avoid false positives - Use water detection (NDWI or water classification) - Compare land pixels between the two dates 3. Logic: - Valid detection of new land = A (Yes) - No new land detected = B (No) - No images for either date = C1 - All pixels masked/invalid = C2 - Calculation fails = C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // Define location and area of interest (4 km radius) const centerPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([49.357405, 39.014501]); const aoi = centerPoint.buffer(4000); // 4 km radius // Date ranges (±3 days window for each date) const date1Start = '2022-11-16'; const date1End = '2022-11-22'; const date2Start = '2023-02-10'; const date2End = '2023-02-16'; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate water mask (NDWI < 0 = land, NDWI > 0 = water) function addWaterMask(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); const land = ndwi.lt(0).rename('land'); // Land where NDWI < 0 return image.addBands([ndwi, land]); } // Get Sentinel-2 data for Nov 2022 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addWaterMask); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 2022 images found: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No images for Nov 2022'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get Sentinel-2 data for Feb 2023 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addWaterMask); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2023 images found: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No images for Feb 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Create composites for each period const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // Count valid pixels for Nov 2022 const count1 = img1.select('land').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 2022 valid pixels: ${count1}`); if (count1 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for Nov 2022 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Count valid pixels for Feb 2023 const count2 = img2.select('land').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2023 valid pixels: ${count2}`); if (count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for Feb 2023 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate land area for each period const landStats1 = img1.select('land').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const landStats2 = img2.select('land').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const landPixels1 = landStats1.get('land').getInfo(); const landPixels2 = landStats2.get('land').getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 2022 land pixels: ${landPixels1}`); console.log(`Feb 2023 land pixels: ${landPixels2}`); if (landPixels1 === null || landPixels2 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if significant new land appeared (threshold: >100 pixels = ~0.1 km²) const landIncrease = landPixels2 - landPixels1; console.log(`Land pixel increase: ${landIncrease}`); // An island "appeared" if there's a significant increase in land area if (landIncrease > 100) { console.log('Island detected - significant land increase'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant island appearance detected'); console.log('B'); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
